Christmas market 'absolutely vital' for businesses
Independent businesses say the Christmas market in the city is vital to their yearly trade.
The Truro market was packed full of shoppers today, as it began its 34 days of festive fare.
Nick White from Kyn Events said: "It's a big time of year for them to end on a high."
He added the market was "absolutely vital" for independent businesses.
